dedupe_keys.name: eu digital building stock model dbsm r2025 building level database with rooftop pv potential

description: The EU Digital Building Stock Model (DBSM) is a JRC geospatial database of individual buildings in the European Union focused on energy-related characteristics, meant to support the Energy Performance of Buildings Directive, the Renovation Wave and affordable housing analysis. Release R2025 (issued May 2025) conflates EUBUCCO, OpenStreetMap and Microsoft building footprints, repairs and de-duplicates them in EPSG:3035, and adds satellite-based height, use type, compactness and construction epoch through the JRC Building Data Integrator, covering all of EU27 including the Azores, Madeira and the Canary Islands. A November 2025 update added floor area and building-level rooftop PV potential (technical capacity and yearly yield from PVGIS, with 25 per cent of residential and 40 per cent of non-residential roof area usable); Italy and Czechia received PV fields in January 2026. The Nature Energy paper by Kakoulaki and co-authors uses it to estimate 2.3 TWp of potential on 271 million buildings. An earlier R2023 release of footprints remains available. Coverage: EU27. Access: free per-country GeoPackages and open workflow code. Licence: ODbL for the dataset, with a CC BY 4.0 copyright notice. Caveats: attributes are modelled, and the changelog records source swaps that change counts in Italy and Czechia. Simulation uses: building-level exposure, renovation and rooftop PV scenario models across Europe. Related records: EUBUCCO, GlobalBuildingAtlas and the EU rooftop PV potential maps.
